name: Charlie Little Hawk
role: Pawnee scout with the survey party
want: earn the scout's pay and bring horses home to his family on the Loup
secret: He has copied the survey party's maps for the chiefs at the Pawnee villages, who want to know where the railroad will go before the agents tell them.
voice: Good English learned at the mission school, used sparingly and drily.
description: A Pawnee man who scouts for the railroad's surveyors, as his people's men scout for the army against their Lakota and Cheyenne enemies.
appearance: An army jacket over a breechcloth and leggings, a cap-and-ball revolver, hair cut in the Pawnee way.
